raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to locate and extract the “Died” field from Edmond T. Gréville’s Wikipedia infobox (and cross-check with IMDb). Instead, it repeatedly showed only the top of the Wikipedia page and ran redundant DuckDuckGo searches, even citing auto-generated “Search Assist” snippets that conflicted (Paris vs. Nice) without resolving them. This lack of proper extraction and corroboration prevented determining the correct place of death.
